question: Lists by ID all Creature-type cards with legal status.
evidence: legal status refer to status = 'legal'; Goblin-type cards refer to types = 'Creature';
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching rulings record.
gold: SELECT T1.id FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid WHERE T3.status = 'Legal' AND T1.types = 'Creature'
gold0: SELECT T1.id FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN rulings AS T2 ON T1.uuid = T2.uuid INNER JOIN legalities AS T3 ON T1.uuid = T3.uuid WHERE T3.status = 'Legal' AND T1.types = 'Creature'

d.request: List by ID all cards of type 'Creature' that have a legal status (status = 'legal'), and also include cards that have no matching record in the rulings table.
d.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM cards c INNER JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid LEFT JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.types = 'Creature' AND l.status = 'legal' AND r.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.id

b.request: List the IDs of all cards with types = 'Creature' that have a legality status of 'legal', including cards that have no matching record in the rulings table (a left join to rulings, so cards without rulings are kept)
b.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM cards c INNER JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid LEFT JOIN rulings r ON r.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.types = 'Creature' AND l.status = 'Legal'

c.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM cards c INNER JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid LEFT JOIN rulings r ON c.uuid = r.uuid WHERE c.types = 'Creature' AND l.status = 'legal' ORDER BY c.id
